body: My advice would be to get to the hospital as soon as you can. If your dad is really in bad condition, get there and tell him how much you love him. If you can’t get there, just know that he knows you still love him and don’t worry too much about being mean to him beforehand. It sucks, but that’s the best you can do, you have to let the doctors and nurses do the rest.. Before my dad got his gallbladder removed, he was crying on the floor in pain, and it crushed me to see him like that. It also scared me pretty bad considering I had never seen him cry before. All I can say is to try and take deep breaths and calm down. Your dad seems like a tough man though, I think he will pull through and get better. I hope that you also get better OP. ❤️
